note: Private campground on the former KOA site at 39761 River Drive near Valentine, reopened 2024 and still being renovated; sewer at only some sites, so ask when booking. Near the Niobrara River (300+ m through trees and homes, not on the water) and the Cowboy Trail's old train bridge. Couples camper, pod and primitive cabin rentals too. Must be 21+ to register; one camping unit per site. --Claude

flags: Gate facts (private): 2026 rate $35 a night tax included (operator pricing page), under US$50. Presence: website riverhideout.com + phone 402-389-0069 (matches Google; second line 402-389-1772), plus Google 4.5 from 14 reviews. RV Life 4.5 from 2 reviews: 8/2026 $40 ('Park is coming along'), 6/2026 $35 ('walking distance of the Niobrara River'). Nothing under 4 stars.

Long-stay tests: pass. A nightly rate is posted, no weekly/monthly/seasonal rates, reservations by arrival/departure date for a season, cabin and pod rentals for short stays. The rules' 'No excessive patio furniture... No carpet on the grass' is ordinary campground boilerplate, not seasonal-lease language.

Waterfront (no change, not waterfront confirmed; re-audited against the site's 'located along the Niobrara River'): imagery puts the camping area around the pin on open sandy ground with the Niobrara 300+ m north-west, behind a belt of trees, homes and a large shed. 'Along the river' means the property's neighbourhood, not riverfront sites. Imagery may predate the renovation.
Sites: the stored count 20 (derived from the old note) is not stated on any operator page; left. 'Limited sewer' means some sites only, which the hookups group can't say (sewer true kept).
Season: closed for the winter now ('2026 Season has come to an end'); opening/closing dates not posted. year_round false (derived) left as is.
Under construction: 'The campground is currently being renovated, however we are taking reservations'. Worth a re-check in 2027.
Pin OK (camp loop at the pin on imagery).
